protected_rules: Keep all source and benchmarks/results evidence.
Keep all release artifacts and Linux final artifacts; only older finalized Linux incremental sessions selected.
Keep two newest macOS executable variants for each Cargo unit/profile/features/rustflags key.
Keep every current macOS full-gate executable, all top-level debug executable inodes, and every explicitly identified MinIO client binary.
Keep newest incremental session for each unit except old macOS units whose object inodes map exclusively to listed superseded executable prefixes.
Do not remove anything if builds restart; recheck path identities and current artifacts before actual deletion.
Disk recovery estimate accounts for hard links; APFS snapshots or clone sharing may reduce observed free-space gain.
